Ingest review for the collection window ending in the third week. The pipeline processed forty-two thousand documents from six source systems without a parser failure. Two sources delivered mixed encodings and were normalized before hashing. Markings were captured as raw strings on every envelope and left unparsed pending the banner parser. Near-duplicate rates were not measured on this window; the exact duplicate count was one hundred and twelve, almost all of them repeated distribution copies of the same weekly bulletin. Recommend measuring near duplicates before the corpus is released for retrieval.
